title: #IUIC #Bishop #Nathanyel7 #IsraelUnitedInChrist
segments: the world gathers under Bright Lights
cheering for a game rooted in Greek
fashion a legacy of idolatry spectacle
and deception a modern day Coliseum
where our people are entertained while
remaining blind to their true Heritage
and identity but the prophets of the
most high are not deceived the book of
mccabes warns us for it was not enough
for them to sin but they built places of
exercise after the manner of the Heathen
and so in the midst of this Grand
Illusion the prophets of IU I se took to
the streets a blitz against sin a stand
for truth a wakeup call for our people
to repent and return to the Commandments
come out of her my people that ye be not
